thread.title: EOG Resources Beats, Targets Higher Dividend Growth; Parsley Tops

author: GILLIAN RICH
title: EOG Resources Beats, Targets Higher Dividend Growth; Parsley Tops
text:
EOG Resources ( EOG ) easily beat Q1 views and said it expects to boost dividend growth, while Parsley Energy ( PE ) also topped, as shale exploration and production companies continue to report strong results.
X
EOG Estimates: Earnings seen soaring 573% to $1.01 per share with revenue rising 32% to $3.46 billion.
Results: EPS of $1.19 on revenue of $3.68 billion. Total production grew 15.6% to 659,900 barrels of oil equivalent per day. Crude oil production grew 15% to 363,300 barrels a day on premium drilling and technical advances. EOG had 19 rigs in the Delaware Basin in Q1 vs.13 rigs at the end of 2017 and brought 12 wells online in the Powder River Basin in Montana and Wyoming during Q1.
Outlook : EOG reiterated its 2018 oil production growth target of 16%-20% and its full-year exploration and development budget forecast of $5.4 billion-$5.8 billion. Total Q2 production is seen at 670,300-706,200 BOE per day and full-year output is seen at 685,800-728,500 BOE per day.
Management is also targeting an increase in its dividend growth rate vs. the 19% compound annual rate from 1999 to 2017.
"The shift to premium drilling and the recovery in oil prices have increased EOG's after-tax rate of return on new investments to record levels," the company said in a statement. "With an improving financial condition, EOG now aims to grow its dividend at a higher rate than its historical average."
Stock: EOG dropped 2% late. Shares closed down 0.55% at 116.01 on the stock market today , still near a 119.10 buy point from a cup base. EOG cleared that threshold intraday on Monday but closed below it.
Last quarter, EOG took a measured tone on future drilling activity despite raising its capital spending by $1 billion this year with oil prices on the rebound.
EOG is nicknamed the " Apple ( AAPL ) of oil" by analysts for its technical innovation in drilling and completion techniques.

Please contact customer service CLOSE Parsley Energy Estimates: EPS climbing 46.7% to 22 cents with revenue jumping 73% to $348 million.
Results: EPS of 31 cents on revenue of $392.4 million. Total production leapt 70.6% to 93,444 barrels of oil equivalent per day, as net oil production jumped 57% to 59,341 barrels per day.
"Accelerated development last year not only gave Parsley a head start on securing high quality services and equipment, the corresponding production uplift also means we are benefiting disproportionately from currently higher oil prices," Chairman and CEO Bryan Sheffield said in a statement. "While Parsley is well positioned to benefit from ongoing oil price strength, operational continuity at a steady development pace remains our highest priority this year."
Shares: Parsley jumped 4% late. Shares finished 2.8% lower at 29.29.
EOG and Parsley's results follow estimate beats from Matador Resources ( MTDR ), Continental Resources ( CLR ) and Pioneer Natural Resources ( PXD ) late Wednesday.
On Tuesday, Viper Energy Partners ( VNOM ), Anadarko Petroleum ( APC ), Noble Energy ( NBL ) and Concho Resources ( CXO ) topped quarterly estimates .
